watch.summary: A streamer playing Prop Hunt is stumped trying to find an opponent until he looks up and discovers them hiding high on the ceiling.

beats.what: The streamer admits he cannot figure out where the hidden player is.
He tilts his camera up towards the roof structure.
He shoots the hidden player clinging directly to the ceiling structure.
Streamer laughs in disbelief at the absurd hiding spot.

watch.author: opponent
watch.key_line: how can you stay on the wall on the roof bro
watch.why: The visual surprise of finding a player sticking to the high ceiling provides a fast, satisfying comedic reveal. The creator's genuine laughter and disbelief make the reaction infectious.
